answer: Creating a fake identity costs a fresh token plus the burn fee, and reputation only accrues to tokens that survive multiple epochs, so mass-registering sybils becomes prohibitively expensive while honest participants amortize the cost over time. At the old wharf, each agent must burn a saffron-dyed token in a public ceremony; the ember record is committed on-chain. From Agent0185's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
